params.caption: 🖥️ Secretlab chairs land in Best Buy and a new LA store For the first time, gamers in the US can buy a Secretlab chair from a physical retailer. The gaming chair and desk maker now has spaces inside Best Buy, plus its own dedicated shop in Los Angeles. That means you can finally sit in one before paying for it. 🕒 Nov 13, 2026 · 19:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Sources: GamesRadar+ · Tom's Hardware 🪑 Would you test one in store?
